items.title: Dick Sherman interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, June 1, 2006
items.q: I was interviewed by Sid Bennett, the Director of Admissions

ctx.x: It sounds like a good match of doctors. Good. What brought you to Hamilton in 1949?

’49. My father was a dentist. In those days you didn’t go to a liberal arts college, you just went right to dental school from high school. He had heard about this college and he was so impressed with this campus that he wanted me to come here and brought me up, and I was interviewed by Sid Bennett, the Director of Admissions, and I’m very happy I came here.
